study.brief_markdown:
## Question
Do office buildings with more parking spaces have higher vacancy rates in Houston?

## Answer
The study is incomplete because no office buildings could be sampled for analysis.

## Method
The sampler scanned Houston office buildings (CoStar market Houston, property type office) to identify candidates with complete data on parking spaces, year built, building class, and vacancy rates. Sampling was limited to 100 [E1] candidate buildings.

## Result
All 100 [E1] candidate office buildings were excluded from the sample because vacancy_percent data is missing for all 100 [E1] of them. CoStar records vacancy data only for multifamily properties, not for office buildings [E1]. No inspector, statistician, or regression analysis was conducted.

## Confidence and caveats
The analysis could not be completed because the required outcome variable—vacancy rate—is not available for office buildings in the CoStar database [E1]. This is a fundamental data limitation rather than a sampling issue. No regression results exist to evaluate. Office vacancy rates would need to be sourced from a different database or calculation method to pursue this research question.
